narrative.overview: Ink on paper, flat and square, with system font stacks and a mono voice for instrument-like labels. Colour is reserved for severity. Source of truth is public/styles.css; DESIGN.md mirrors it.
keyCharacteristics: One stylesheet, public/styles.css, shared by all pages
Single light theme, no dark mode
No border-radius, one box-shadow (field focus halo)
Colour only for severity, always paired with words

rules.name: The Contrast-Checked Rule
rules.body: Each severity colour is contrast-checked against --paper, since a tool that grades contrast has no business failing it (public/styles.css:13).

rules.name: The Words-Too Rule
rules.body: Colour is never the only carrier of a verdict; the status column says the same in words (public/styles.css:461).

dos: Do use colour only to carry severity or verdict, and pair it with words.
Do contrast-check any new severity colour against --paper before adding it.
Do keep wide tables scrolling inside their own box.
Do keep a screen-reader prefix on bare clause numbers.
donts: Don't add aria-hidden, hidden, inert or display:none to the analysis stage (public/axe-runner.js:51).
Don't outline #results on focus; it is a programmatic focus target, not a control (public/styles.css:52).
